decisions.summary: split the extra volume of Heel counter type 6 with a second supplier

messages.author: EMP-001
messages.text: Can Baxter Inc [SYNTH] cover a 20% forecast increase on Heel counter type 6 in Q3?

messages.author: EMP-003
messages.text: They can do 10% from the current plant, the rest needs overtime.

messages.author: EMP-001
messages.text: Decision: split the extra volume of Heel counter type 6 with a second supplier.
